data.name: Brodie Biomass
data.description: Brodie Biomass is a biochar production arm of Brodie Farms, a family-owned Surrey farming group that diversified into pyrolysis in 2024 using a £1.3M HSBC green loan. It produces EBC-certified biochar from locally sourced woodchip, sells biochar and biochar-composts (including through the acquired SoilFixer brand), and registers carbon removal credits with Puro.earth. The biochar venture is positioned as diversification alongside the family's core farming and wood-recycling operations.
